messages:
emma_cs: Quick synthesis from today's 7 onboarding calls — wanted to surface the recurring product asks before we hand off to Product. TL;DR below, will follow with raw snippets.
lisa_csm: love it, thanks. drop the bullets so we can tag by renewal risk.
noah_se: can you include which customers mentioned it and any timing (blocking vs nice-to-have)?
emma_cs: yep. kept it concise — added [renewal=high|med|low] per account call.

emma_cs: 1) Per-route billing toggle — ask: ability to disable expensive routes (e.g., high-cost reranking) per customer or route-level cap. Mentioned by 3 pilots (Acme Retail, HelixCardio, NorthBay). Impact: cost savings for pilot customers, reduces churn risk. Renewal: high for Acme Retail.
lisa_csm: Acme made this a hard ask for renewals — flagged it high.

emma_cs: 2) Bulk user CSV import for onboarding — ask: admin UI to upload CSV with role mapping + API endpoint for large orgs. Mentioned by 4 accounts (NorthBay, Velociti, Greenbridge, Broadview). Impact: reduces onboarding effort from days to hours. Renewal: med.

emma_cs: 3) Session-level KV cache visibility — ask: show cache hit/miss per session in Console and include TTL defaults in API docs. Mentioned by 2 early-adopters (Telos Health, Nimbus). Impact: helps debug latency/cost regressions. Renewal: low but high enablement value.

emma_cs: 4) Embed caching + per-embedding eviction policy — ask: ability to set TTL or LRU for embeddings and version tags. Mentioned by BrightLane and ParkCo. Impact: cost / perf optimization for similarity search. Renewal: med.

emma_cs: 5) Invite flow friction — ask: invite emails get lost; want magic-link + org-level SSO enforcement toggle. Mentioned by 5 accounts. Impact: onboarding dropoff. Renewal: med/high depending on ARR.

devon_pm: this is great — can we add a short prioritization rubric: Customer ARR, renewal risk, dev effort (S/M/L), and immediate impact?

emma_cs: yes. quick table (short):
- Acme Retail: Per-route billing toggle | ARR: $350k | Renewal: high | Effort: M | Impact: immediate
- NorthBay: Bulk CSV import | ARR: $120k | Renewal: med | Effort: S | Impact: high for enablement
- Velociti: Bulk CSV import | ARR: $95k | Renewal: med | Effort: S | Impact: high
- HelixCardio: Per-route billing toggle | ARR: $220k | Renewal: high | Effort: M | Impact: immediate
- BrightLane: Embedding eviction policy | ARR: $60k | Renewal: low | Effort: L | Impact: perf/cost

emma_cs: Proposed next steps: 1) Product triage meeting w/ @devon_pm and @kai_prod tomorrow 10:30am PT, 2) Add these three highest-impact asks to the 2-week discovery sprint (Per-route billing, CSV import, Invite flow), 3) Share updated notes with customers (short commit + timeline).

kai_prod: I can take Per-route billing as PM owner. tagging infra for feasibility check.
devon_pm: I'll scope CSV import and invite flow; need eng effort estimate from eng infra.
lisa_csm: I'll prepare short customer-facing notes — two bullets each and expected ETA. want to keep expectations tight.

feedbackbot: Added labels: onboarding:feature-request, renewal-risk:high, priority:needs-triage.

noah_se: heads up — Acme asked for a canary flag so we can roll per-customer. that ups complexity but may be necessary.
emma_cs: noted. Kai & Devon — please surface canary/flag complexity in triage.

devon_pm: ack. let's meet 10:30am PT. If we can ship CSV import as a small admin feature + API, that might reduce churn quickest.
lisa_csm: thanks team — I'll paste call transcripts in a follow-up thread and ping customers after triage. :thumbsup:

emma_cs: Thanks all — putting calendar invite now and will attach raw notes. End.
